data.text:
B.Prahalad vs The Government Of Andhra Pradesh on 17
October, 2024
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice T. Madhavi Devi
 Writ Petition (Tr) No.1187 of 2017
Order:
This Writ Petition(TR) is filed for continuing the petitioner's service on deputation basis till the
direct recruitment quota is filled up. 
2. The Andhra Pradesh Administrative Tribunal, vide orders d ated 04.12.2013 in O.A.No.8324 of 2013, had directed the respondents to continue the petitioner as Food Safety Officer, Nizamabad, if he has not yet been relieved from the post. 
3. Thereafter, on abolition of the Tribunal by the Government of Telangana, the said O.A. has been transferred to this Court and it is renumbered as Writ Petition (TR) No.1187 of 2017.
4. No counter-affidavit is filed and there is no appearance on behalf of the petitioner before this Court.
5. In view of the same, this Court is of the opinion that no further orders are required in this matter,
accordingly, Writ Petition (TR) is closed as infructuous, with liberty to the petitioner to seek recall of this order, in case the cause in the Writ Petition(TR) survives. No order as to costs. 
Miscellaneous applications, if any, pending in this Writ Petition, shall stand closed. 
______________________ JUSTICE T. MADHAVI DEVI Date: 17.10.2024 SHA B.Prahalad vs The Government Of Andhra Pradesh on 17 October, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109706015/
